verdict.rationale: mParticle's docs include a section titled "Transform data as it enters and leaves mParticle", and its forwarding rules can filter outbound data (for example, not forwarding when a CCPA opt-out is present). The evidence is only a doc title plus consent-based filtering, with no description of custom code or functions. missing for 10: evidence of custom code or function-based transforms, event enrichment logic, general-purpose in-pipeline filtering beyond consent rules, detailed transformation docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can transform, filter, and enrich events in-pipeline with custom code or functions before they reach destinations

citations.quote: Transform data as it enters and leaves mParticle
Applying a forwarding rule of: Do not forward if CCPA Data sale opt out is present.
